Game Overview

Fly vs Giant puts players into a casual experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Fly vs Giant doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Fly vs Giant?

Fly vs Giant is a free casual game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Fly vs Giant free to play?

Yes, Fly vs Giant is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
